rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Gentle west kerb where cars park, but homes sit 10-12 m behind it.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12 m back at 15 m and 10 m back at 33 m, with hedges between; units across the road are over 25 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane; a few cars already park along this kerb, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Collector-type street with a busy junction 20-30 m south; passing traffic and some noise.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; a van would blend in.

flags: Homes 10-12 m away on the same side
Noise from the busy junction and road
Grade 3.5% here; max 9.8% on the full stretch
sun_shade: Mostly open; garden trees and hedge give partial shade from the west; east trees shade the street.

best_section.where: West kerb of Manchester Terrace between the two house frontages, 20 m north of the main-road junction
